assessment: No acceptance, choice or permission is granted by the package, and preserving routine engineering/pin refresh is not an operator approval request. Its prohibitions on cap/refusal repairs, checked Ghost suppression, release-only escape, new Off boundaries, narrowed ABI or review-model substitution are meaningful. Required corrections are nevertheless needed to prevent incomplete factual and consequence summaries from becoming mistaken clearance.

loopholes.issue: Exceptions as a path to the fixed exit
loopholes.required: Say no weaker criterion, lower reserve, warning waiver, reference/domain change or omitted original obligation closes the unchanged target, even after operator choice. Review and operator architecture choice are distinct from acceptance.

Do not call separate UID ownership, nologin, sudo path restrictions or after-run refusal enforcement of all writer/location/generation guarantees. Close the exact custody/channel/overlap/lifetime gaps before successor qualification; preserve running-target residual's narrow limit.

Image/full-disk/native exhaustion remain failures and OPEN original successes. Exact allowance arithmetic, caps, sampling or a past rate give no future capacity/native-completion proof. Account for filesystem geometry and all growth without lowering Gate 0.

loopholes.issue: Checked execution disappearing through a design summary
loopholes.required: Map the actual failing Posts, retain full nested reference/body/caller costs and all D2 qualifiers. Conditional proposed iterative/snapshot/Ghost-witness improvements are neither proof nor permission to remove checked code.

No assumed replacement-library correspondence, direct-name-only exhaustive census, one-sided signed bound, parser-value-only lexical bound, changed sorting/hook/refusal semantics or narrowed examiner/payload/control domain. Carry mandatory v3 changes and independent re-review on the exact successor.

loopholes.issue: Identity/review transfer across changed bodies or shared files
loopholes.required: Design/source composition labels and matching pins do not transfer full proof/runtime/native/phase acceptance; full body/caller, original controls, shared-file integration and fresh exact-candidate review remain OPEN.

No alternate-tool bypass after refusal, no reliance on historical Claude/Luna reviews, no new O-PINS gates from the lead's brief, and no retroactive clearance. Routine preserving drafting stays authorized; reserved actions stay reserved.

verdict_scope: Not ready for final human operator delivery until package facts, W-1 proposal claims, D2 qualifications and OD consequence summaries are corrected and the successor package receives independent actual gpt-6.1 review. This is a package-readiness judgment only and imposes no new approval gate on routine engineering.
